Immolate

Tooltip

Burns the enemy for Fire damage and then an additional 275 Fire damage over 15 sec.

How it works

Each cast of Immolate costs 380 Mana. Casting it triggers a 1.5 sec global cooldown. Its dispel type is client id 1.

Immolate is built from 3 client effects, applied in this order:

  1. Effect 1 is Apply Aura (effect type 6). It applies aura type 3. Its base value is 55 per tick. It scales with 0.13 times spell power. It ticks every 3 sec, 5 times over the full 15 sec (275 base in total).
  2. Effect 2 is School Damage (effect type 2). Its base value is 158. It scales with 0.2 times spell power.
  3. Effect 3 is effect type 77, which the datamine does not name. Its base value is 100.

What it does

Immolate is a Fire spell with a 2 sec cast, a range of 30 yards and effects that last 15 sec. When cast it applies an aura every 3 sec and deals Fire damage (base value 158).

Generated from the SpellEffect, SpellMisc, SpellCooldowns and SpellRange records in the WoW Forever beta client, build 1.60.1.70450. Effects the client marks as internal hooks are left out.
